project_name: MyGenie Restaurant POS - Unified High-Converting Lead Form for AI Voice Agent Asha
target_audience: Restaurant and food business owners in India (ages 30–55 across metros and Tier 2 cities, primarily mobile, booking a free product demo)
emotional_tone: Warm, trustworthy, razor-sharp operational authority, friction-free hospitality tech (Archetype 1 Organic & Earthy meets Swiss Precision)

two_tier_form_architecture.overview: Asha dials within 60 seconds of form submission. Tier 1 collects the critical qualification signals immediately to pre-arm Asha's greeting and branch script. Tier 2 collects operational details (outlet type, outlet count, vintage) post-lead creation without adding pre-submit friction.

tier_1_main_form.placement: Homepage Hero, Petpooja Alternative landing page, 5 Ad landing pages, and Mobile DemoBottomSheet
tier_1_main_form.max_visible_elements: 7-8 elements total before submit button to keep completion rate above 35%

fields.name: name
fields.purpose: Asha greets lead by first name

fields.name: phone
fields.purpose: Primary key and number Asha dials within 60 seconds

fields.name: business_name
fields.purpose: Maps to Freshsales job_title; Asha references restaurant by name

fields.name: business_status
fields.label: Business Status
fields.purpose: Tells Asha whether lead has existing billing ops or is pre-launch (determines pitch urgency)

fields.name: using_pos
fields.label: How do you bill today?
fields.purpose: Asha skips initial questions; triggers conditional software picker

fields.name: current_pos
fields.label: Which software are you using?
fields.purpose: If Petpooja is selected, Asha immediately quotes comparison advantages and migration guarantees

tier_2_enrichment_step.placement: Appears directly after lead creation (either before/after OTP or seamlessly on Thank You page)
tier_2_enrichment_step.headline: Tell us a bit about your outlet (Optional)
tier_2_enrichment_step.sub: Helps our POS specialist tailor your live walkthrough.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read /app/design_guidelines.json thoroughly before editing any files.
Edit existing DemoForm.jsx and DemoBottomSheet.jsx in-place (do not rename or delete).
Keep React 19 + Tailwind CSS setup. All chip components must use pure Tailwind CSS with zero extra libraries.
Ensure total visible form elements in Tier 1 stay between 7 and 8 before CTA to protect conversion rate.
Verify all input fields and one-tap chips include explicit data-testid attributes for testing.
Retain the 3-stage progress indicator ('form' -> 'otp' -> 'calendly') on all forms.
On PetpoojaAlternative.jsx, ensure DemoForm runs in full mode without shortForm, with default billing set to Software / Petpooja.
Ensure mobile bottom sheet remains accessible, dismissible, and touch-optimized with 44px+ hit areas.

prohibitions: DO NOT use generic full-screen gradients or dark gradient overlays.
DO NOT use pure black #000000 or grey-on-grey text with low contrast.
DO NOT use text-align: center on the main container.
DO NOT hide desktop navigation links behind a hamburger menu.
DO NOT introduce new npm dependencies for chip selection.
requirements: All interactive elements must feature distinct hover, active, and focus-visible states.
Every button and input must have a descriptive kebab-case data-testid attribute.
Input font sizes must be at least 15px (ideally 16px on mobile) to prevent mobile Safari iOS zoom.
Chip groups must use keyboard-friendly focus styles and accessible roles.
